text:
Sam: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal: canonicalize a tiny set of observability keys at the edge (sidecar/proxy) so downstream pipelines and cost attribution don’t have to handle dozens of client variants.

Maria: Sounds useful. Which keys are we standardizing? Need sampling + billing impact.

Sam: Draft mapping (edge injects X-Obs-* while preserving originals, adds provenance header):

```
tenant_id | tenant | x-tenant -> X-Obs-Tenant
svc_env | env -> X-Obs-Env
billing_key | account_id -> X-Obs-Billing
trace_id | x-trace-id -> X-Obs-Trace
sample_hint | x-sample -> X-Obs-SampleHint
```

Sam: Also inject `X-Obs-Orig-Keys` = comma list of original header names, so consumers can migrate. No dropping of originals in Phase A.

Josh: Perf notes: adding header ops in the sidecar microbench shows <1% CPU at 1% rollout, but we should canary. Also: if billing remap happens, make sure cost-aggregation uses X-Obs-Billing exclusively to avoid double-counting.

Anya: Sampling: earlier canonicalization lets edge make consistent sample decisions. We should surface original sampling hint via X-Obs-SampleHint when present. If edge decides to sample, add X-Obs-Sampled=true.

Kevin: Precedence when multiple sources disagree? Propose deterministic order: client header > auth token claims > query param > none. Document this.

Sam: Will add precedence doc. Also propose validation for X-Obs-Billing: only propagate when it matches auth-claim pattern or token-introspect result, otherwise leave empty to avoid misattribution.

Maria: Migration plan proposal:
1) Phase A (2w): edge injects X-Obs-* and X-Obs-Orig-Keys; pipelines unchanged. Emit metric: obs.edge.canonicalized_pct and obs.edge.missing_billing_pct.
2) Phase B (4w): consumers prefer X-Obs-* but accept originals. Add regression alert on billing delta > 2%.
3) Phase C (30d after stable): deprecate originals and flip read-only to X-Obs-*.

Josh: Implementation: sidecar feature flag `obs.canonicalize=true` with rollout percent. Add opt-out header `X-Obs-Raw: true` for customers who need unmodified headers.

Anya: Dashboards: create alias layer so saved queries using old keys continue to work during Phase B. We'll add query aliases mapping old_field -> X_Obs_Field.

Kevin: Backfill: billing reconciliation job should have a one-off transform that reads historical envelopes, infers canonical keys using same precedence, writes canonicalized rows for accurate re-aggregation. This will be heavy but acceptable as a one-time job.

Sam: Edge cases: internal service-to-service calls with no tenant in auth token should NOT invent tenant. Keep X-Obs-Billing empty and let routing fallback handle it.

ingest-bot: Deploy-check: canary pool size recommended = 1% of ingress. Add perf job: `obs-edge-header-canary` to run during canary window.

Maria: Owners: Sam (RFC + edge change), Josh (runtime perf + canary infra), Anya (sampling & analytics), Kevin (billing/backfill).

Sam: I'll open a short RFC doc with rollout checklist and the precedence/validation rules. Any objections? :eyes:

Kevin: No objections. I'll draft backfill plan and estimate cost.

Josh: SGTM. Scheduling perf run tomorrow.

Anya: SGTM from analytics. We'll prepare alias layer and a dashboard to track canonicalization adoption.

Maria: OK start Phase A next week. :rocket:
